contribute.title: Ways to help
contribute.body:
### Help Vommet

**1. Hire the maintainer** — Hire me if you’re looking for a programmer, Linux sysadmin, or networking guru.

**2. Dart and Flutter** — Help develop and maintain Vommet. Discuss larger changes before starting.

**3. AI-assisted work** — AI-assisted contributions are welcome. Disclose AI use; a human is responsible for reading and testing the work.

**4. Test Vommet** — Try builds and report reproducible problems.

**5. App-store packaging** — Help package Vommet for Google Play and the Apple App Store.
